title: Dua Before Eating
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيمَا رَزَقْتَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
english: O Allah, bless us in what You have provided us with and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

title: Dua After Eating
arabic: الْـحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَجَعَلَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
english: All praise is for Allah who fed us and gave us drink and made us Muslims.

title: Dua Before Sleeping
arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
english: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

title: Dua After Waking Up
arabic: الْـحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
english: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us, and unto Him is the resurrection.

title: Dua Before Studying
arabic: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
english: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

title: Dua Asking for Wisdom
arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ
english: My Lord, grant me wisdom and join me with the righteous.

title: Dua When Leaving the House
arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
english: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no power nor might except with Allah.

title: Dua When Starting a Journey
arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
english: Glory be to Him who has brought this under our control, though we were unable to control it. And indeed, to our Lord we will surely return.

title: Dua After Drinking Water
arabic: الْـحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي سَقَانَا عَذْبًا فُرَاتًا بِرَحْمَتِهِ وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْهُ مِلْحًا أُجَاجًا بِذُنُوبِنَا
english: All praise is for Allah who gave us sweet, refreshing water by His mercy and did not make it salty and bitter due to our sins.

title: Dua After Sneezing
arabic: الْـحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ. يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ. يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ
english: All praise be to Allah. May Allah have mercy on you. May Allah guide you and rectify your condition.

title: Dua When Wearing New Clothes
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيهِ، أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهِ وَخَيْرِ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ
english: O Allah, praise is to You. You have clothed me. I ask You for its goodness and the goodness of what it has been made for, and I seek Your protection from the evil of it and the evil of what it has been made for.

title: Dua When Looking Into the Mirror
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ حَسَّنْتَ خَلْقِي فَحَسِّنْ خُلُقِي
english: O Allah, just as You have made my external features beautiful, make my character beautiful as well.

title: Dua Upon Completing a Task
arabic: تَمَّ بِحَمْدِ اللَّهِ
english: Completed with the praise of Allah.

title: Dua Asking Allah for Protection
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ
english: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from anxiety and sorrow.

title: Dua Seeking Forgiveness
arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
english: I seek forgiveness from Allah and repent to Him.

title: Dua Asking for Mercy
arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
english: My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful.

title: Dua for Protection at Night
arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ
english: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing can cause harm.

title: Dua for Safety From Evil
arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
english: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

title: Dua for Parents
arabic: رَبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
english: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up when I was small.

title: Dua Asking for Good Manners
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي لِأَحْسَنِ الْأَخْلَاقِ
english: O Allah, guide me to the best of manners.

title: Dua Seeking Blessing for the Day
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ
english: O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day.

title: Dua Asking for Guidance
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنَا فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ
english: O Allah, guide us among those You have guided.

title: Dua Requesting Health and Well-being
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي
english: O Allah, grant me health in my body.

title: Dua Requesting Allah's Light
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا
english: O Allah, place light in my heart.

title: Dua for Jannah
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ
english: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise.

title: Dua When Hearing the Athan
arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
english: There is no might and no power except by Allah.

title: Dua When Rain Is Falling
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا غَيْثًا مُغِيثًا مَرِيئًا مُرِيعًا، نَافِعًا غَيْرَ ضَارٍّ، عَاجِلًا غَيْرَ آجِلٍ
english: O Allah, shower upon us abundant rain, beneficial, not harmful, swiftly and not delayed.

title: Dua After Rainfall
arabic: مُطِرْنَا بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ
english: We have been given rain by the grace and mercy of Allah.

title: Dua Before Entering the Toilet
arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبْثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
english: In the name of Allah. O Allah, I take refuge with You from all evil and evil-doers.

title: Dua After Leaving the Toilet
arabic: غُفْرَانَكَ
english: I ask You, Allah, for forgiveness.
